guidance.sentence: Assuming the continuation of current market conditions as well as constant exchange rates, for the fourth quarter of 2026, Amphenol expects sales to be in the range of $10.3 to $10.5 billion, representing an approximately 60% increase over the prior year quarter.
Adjusted Diluted EPS is expected to be in the range of $0.81 to $0.83, representing a 65% to 69% increase from the fourth quarter of 2025.

For the full year 2026, Amphenol expects sales to be in the range of $36.9 billion to $37.1 billion, representing an approximately 60% increase over prior year, while Adjusted Diluted EPS is expected to be in the range of $2.82 to $2.84, representing an approximately 70% increase over prior year.

For the full year 2026, Amphenol expects sales to be in the range of $36.9 billion to $37.1 billion, representing an approximately 60% increase over prior year, while Adjusted Diluted EPS is expected to be in the range of $2.82 to $2.84, representing an approximately 70% increase over prior year.

In addition, given the continued better-than-expected performance of the CommScope business, Amphenol now expects the business to generate full-year sales of $5.1 billion and to be $0.18 accretive to the Company’s Adjusted Diluted EPS in 2026 which is reflected in our outlook.

In addition, given the continued better-than-expected performance of the CommScope business, Amphenol now expects the business to generate full-year sales of $5.1 billion and to be $0.18 accretive to the Company’s Adjusted Diluted EPS in 2026 which is reflected in our outlook.
The Company estimates acquisition-related costs in the fourth quarter of 2026 of approximately $0.01 per share primarily related to external transaction costs.

summary: Amphenol expects Q4 2026 sales of $10.3 to $10.5 billion and Adjusted Diluted EPS of $0.81 to $0.83, and full-year 2026 sales of $36.9 to $37.1 billion and Adjusted Diluted EPS of $2.82 to $2.84, with higher CommScope sales and accretion expectations reflected.
